If you want an **alternative to Bloomerang**, the most commonly recommended options are **Keela, Givebutter, Donorbox, Little Green Light, Raiser's Edge NXT, Neon CRM, and Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud**.[3][7]

A quick way to narrow it down:

| Best for | Option | Why it stands out |
|---|---|---|
| Small nonprofits | **Little Green Light** | Donor management, fundraising campaigns, constituent records, and reporting in one interface.[3] |
| Easy fundraising and donations | **Givebutter** | All-in-one fundraising platform with a simple interface.[3] |
| Fast setup and recurring gifts | **Donorbox** | Simple setup and strong recurring donation tools.[3] |
| Budget-conscious teams | **Keela** | Frequently listed among top Bloomerang alternatives.[3] |
| Larger or more complex nonprofits | **Raiser's Edge NXT** | Robust fundraising and donor management features.[3] |
| All-in-one nonprofit CRM | **Neon CRM** | Includes event, volunteer, donor communications, and automated receipting tools.[3] |
| Enterprise-level nonprofit operations | **Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud** | Built for a full 360-view of nonprofit operations and stakeholder management.[3] |

If you want a **Bloomerang-like replacement**, **Little Green Light** is often the closest fit for smaller teams, while **Neon CRM** and **Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud** are stronger if you need broader CRM and workflow capabilities.[3][7]

If you tell me your **organization size**, **budget**, and whether you need **fundraising only** or a full **CRM**, I can narrow it to the best 2–3 options.
